notes.NON_COURT: Never contributes court inventory. A bookable PBP resource that is not a court.
notes.ALTERNATE: A court-hire surface that re-exposes courts already counted under a COURT surface, through a different booking/entitlement channel. Never contributes capacity. Relevant at checkout, not at discovery.
notes.UNKNOWN: Not a stored class. What classify() returns for a surface absent from this file. Contributes nothing and must be reviewed.

members_only.evidence: The Rally /courts declares the relationship explicitly: court 16078 'Court 1 - Show Court' carries children_court_ids [18043], and 16089->18045, 16090->18046, 16091->18047, 16092->18048, 16093->18049. Each members_only resource is a declared CHILD of an ordinary court, with children_court_ids empty of its own. Six physical courts, twelve resources.
members_only.consequence: Discovery must materialise each physical court ONCE, from its COURT surface. Showing 'Court 1' and 'Court 1 Overlap' side by side would present one physical court as two bookable units.
members_only.open_purpose: Still unproven, and NOT to be inferred. Member pricing already resolves on the public surface -- pricing ordinary court 16078 returned affiliation 'V2 - Rally Member' at $25 without touching members_only, and a Level Up Pass member at another venue was quoted $30 rather than free. So an entitlement affiliation does not mean permanently free, and the child representation may exist for member-only access windows or a weekly free-hour allowance. Whether PBP selects the representation itself from the user's membership, or expects the child court id to be submitted, must be probed before checkout uses it.
members_only.pairing: RESOLVED. children_court_ids on the parent court is the mapping, by id. No name matching is needed. An earlier probe reported no link field, but it inspected available_courts objects, which carry a thinner shape than /courts.

census.note: Baseline from the unfiltered estate census, 2026-08-19, 21 surfaces across 21 active venues. A surface appearing outside this list on a later cycle is UNKNOWN and must be reviewed before it can contribute inventory.

invariant: One physical court contributes one unit of inventory regardless of how many PBP surfaces expose it.
